phase2.cause: sw.js answered every GET (incl. cross-origin cover ) with fetch(cache:no-store) and only used cache on network failure, so a previously seen cover always waited on the remote host (PriceCharting 1600px, LaunchBox, GameEye). Covers were also stored unbounded in the app-shell cache (opaque responses ~7MB quota each: 9 covers = 72MB).
fix: cross-origin image requests: cache-first from a separate bounded cache shelfcheck-covers-v1 (40 entries, oldest dropped); app code/data unchanged network-first no-store
activate purges cover images from the app-shell cache; cover cache survives shell version bumps
fun-features: warmNextRandomCover() pre-loads the next shuffle-bag pick at idle (read-only peek, 600ms idle timeout)
